name: How do I choose the right height for my picture rail?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right height for my picture rail?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal height for a picture rail often depends on your ceiling height and the overall scale of your room. Traditionally, picture rails are placed about one-fifth to one-quarter of the way down from the ceiling, or aligned with the top of door and window frames. In rooms with high ceilings, placing it slightly lower can make the space feel more intimate. Consider the size of the artwork you plan to hang, ensuring adequate space above and below the rail. Maine Results Inc. can offer expert advice during our on-site visit, helping you determine the most aesthetically pleasing and functional height for your specific space in areas like Meridian or Eagle.
